text:
Noah Kim: hey all, accepted the org invite but GitHub says 'You must enable SAML SSO' even though I completed the SSO web flow. I'm stuck on the mobile app 2FA step because it only shows my personal account's push request. anyone seen this? :confused:

Riley Park: welcome Noah! weird—if you used the GitHub mobile app it can confuse accounts. Did you accept the invite in a desktop browser first and complete the SSO approval?

Noah Kim: i did the SSO on desktop but when GitHub prompted for 2FA it redirected to the GitHub app on my phone which popped my personal account. I approved there and it linked the personal account. now the org membership is attached to that personal account and not my work email.

people-ops: Hi Noah 44b3fb We can reissue the invite to your work email and ensure SSO mapping goes to the right account. Before we do that can you confirm your work email is NOT listed on the personal GitHub account? If it is, remove it to avoid automatic merge.

Noah Kim: confirmed my personal account doesn't have my work email. i'd prefer not to touch my personal account. please resend to noah@redwood.com if possible.

infra-bot: FYI org enforces SSO + 2FA. Reissuing to work email will prompt SSO again and avoid the mobile-account mixup if you accept on desktop.

Sam Wu: Re-sent invite to noah@redwood.com and flagged for SAML SSO. Noah, accept in a desktop browser and when prompted for 2FA use the authenticator app or SMS tied to your work account rather than the GitHub mobile app.

Noah Kim: accepted the new invite on desktop, SSO web flow looked normal. Now it says 'request access' on repo infra-deploy though I should have been auto-added to infra team.

Riley Park: sometimes auto-mapping fails if there was a previous conflicting account. @Sam can you check the onboarding mapping?

Sam Wu: looked into it  there was a stale mapping to the old personal account. Cleared it and manually added Noah to teams: infra, dev-platform. You should now see infra-deploy and repo access.

Noah Kim: can confirm I can clone and push now. one small gotcha for others: if the mobile app is on the phone, it may intercept push approvals for the wrong account. recommend accepting org invites on desktop and using a desktop-based 2FA flow where possible. saved my morning :sweat_smile:

people-ops: Great recap. We'll add a short note to the onboarding invite: "Accept on desktop; if mobile app prompts, make sure it's the work account." Welcome to Redwood! :tada:
